workingTitle: 按独立故障根而非车辆数计算协同证据 quorum

methodObject.messageRoots: R(m) records declared sensor, calibration, map, localization, network, model, and injected fault-process roots for one object or trajectory evidence item.
methodObject.conflictGraph: Two items are connected under a preregistered fault class when they share a root that can fail jointly.
methodObject.effectiveQuorum: q_FD is the largest root-disjoint supporting subset; the small number of cooperative participants permits exact enumeration.
methodObject.claimBoundary: Root-disjoint means no shared declared root, not statistical independence or authenticated provenance.

epistemicStatuses: observed: directly present in public metadata
assigned: set by a simulation or injection manifest
inferred: guessed from output correlation and never used as truth
authenticated: cryptographically bound, which the audited public datasets generally do not provide

nearestWorkBoundary.occupiedSpace: Global, ego, and CAV corruption with positive and negative cooperation metrics, not shared-root quorum.
Vehicle-subset consensus against malicious collaborators; correlated vehicles can still form a false majority.
Random grouping, temporal reference, and vehicle-level Bayesian validation without an audited shared-failure-root model.
Per-agent or per-object probabilistic trust; trust quality is not source independence.
Conservative state-estimate fusion under unknown cross-correlation, not evidence admission for deep cooperative perception.
Abstract fail-prone sets and quorum intersection; failure-domain quorum itself cannot be claimed as new.
Common-cause multi-sensor fault injection in autonomous driving, not cross-vehicle evidence lineage and quorum.

standardBoundary: ISO 26262 dependent-failure analysis supplies hazard vocabulary, not a cooperative evidence algorithm.
ISO 21448 and ISO PAS 8800 cover intended-function and AI insufficiency, not provenance validity.
ETSI CPM exposes originating station and sensor identity or type but not complete model, map, route, and authenticated lineage.
candidateIncrement: An executable evidence-root manifest for cooperative object and trajectory evidence.
A paired protocol that fixes vehicle count, visibility, message bytes, and model while changing only root cardinality.
Root-disjoint admission and per-domain evidence caps with explicit unknown and wrong-lineage sensitivity.
One protocol spanning benign common causes, collusion, and closed-loop propagation while preserving each component's prior-work attribution.

publicEntrypoints.use: Assign independent or shared corruption process IDs in a sidecar manifest; a shared seed is an experimental proxy, not a real common cause.
Observed hardware, calibration, GPS or IMU, and platform domains; mainly V2I and still requires replay injection.
Heterogeneous vehicle and infrastructure platform lineage; checkpoint availability remains an explicit gate.
Assign shared map, weather, calibration, localization, model, and random-process roots without calling them real-world observations.

twoWeekMinimum: Freeze one compatible public checkpoint, model, scene set, vehicle count, visibility, and communication budget.
Construct paired independent-root and common-root corruptions with the same corruption type and severity, plus a shuffled-domain placebo that leaves outputs unchanged.
Compare ego-only, all fusion, vehicle-count voting, ROBOSAC, random collaborator drop, and an oracle domain-collapse diagnostic.
Measure false-evidence acceptance, AP, positive and negative cooperation, calibration, abstention, clean utility, traffic, and latency with scene or route cluster bootstrap.
Do not train a domain inference model in the two-week test.
falsifiableClaims: At fixed vehicle count, common-root replication increases false acceptance or negative cooperation relative to independent roots.
Oracle domain collapse reduces common-root false acceptance without explaining the gain by rejecting nearly all cooperation.
The paired effect transfers to unseen seeds and at least one held-out corruption family.
Duplicating a same-root message never increases q_FD.
Missing, merged, split, and wrong root labels expose the method's provenance dependence rather than being hidden.
sixWeekStudy: Implement an evidence-root hypergraph, q_FD, a per-domain evidence cap, and ego fallback.
Compare vehicle consensus, probabilistic trust, uncertainty weighting, RCP-Drop, and compatible conservative-fusion baselines under the same checkpoint and budget.
Evaluate benign common cause, one attacker, collusion, held-out fault families, taxonomy coarsening, and shuffled or wrong provenance.
Run an OpenCDA closed-loop study and one external replay check on TUMTraf-V2X or V2X-Real when assets permit.
killCriteria: No compatible checkpoint can be replayed by day two.
Paired conditions cannot hold vehicle count, visibility, bytes, and model fixed.
Domain labels are reverse-engineered from ground-truth objects or target predictions.
Benefits require oracle roots and disappear under every observable or assigned provenance variant.
False acceptance continues to rise when identical same-root evidence is cloned.
Two controlled data paths and a held-out fault family show no stable paired effect.
claimGuardrails: Do not claim the first failure-domain quorum.
Do not call different vehicles naturally independent.
Do not equate a shared simulation seed with a real common cause.
Do not claim CPM metadata is authenticated lineage.
Do not convert offline AP into a road-safety claim without a closed-loop intervention.
